info.title: AI Governance Gateway development API
info.description: Management requires RS256 JWTs for the configured issuer/audience and aigw:manage scope. Business roles come from PostgreSQL. Amounts use the organization currency: MOCK integer test units or CNY_MICRO (one yuan = 1,000,000 units). Provider prices are operator-configured, not a supplier invoice. List cursors are keysets, not snapshots.

RequestRecord.description: Budget-backed request metadata only. Accounting state does not prove downstream delivery. Rejections before reservation are absent. No prompts, responses, credentials or inferred model name.

ExecutionAttempt.description: One durable attempt per reserved request; no retries. Completed means valid upstream result and durable local accounting/metadata, not client receipt. Unfinished can include crashed processes. Timing is wall-clock gateway execution time including accounting and metadata writes. Null on old or unrecorded requests.

ProjectLimits.description: Project-wide shared quotas. Default 60 admissions per sliding 60s, four valid concurrency leases, revision zero. Counts are a database snapshot; leases do not prove provider work stopped.

limit_amount.description: Exact integer minor units represented as decimal text to preserve large drift sums.

stored_held.description: Exact integer minor units represented as decimal text to preserve large drift sums.

Inspection.description: Read-only repeatable-read diagnostic snapshot. Organization totals only for org owner/admin. Aged records are review candidates, not proof of abandoned provider work. No refunds, replay or balance correction.

buckets.description: Cumulative latency counts <=100,500,1000,5000,30000,120000 ms. HTTP semantics; SSE errors may retain HTTP 200.

tracked.description: False if this scope has no completed observation or the 4096-scope instance limit was reached.

held_amount.description: All periods combined in the project currency, smallest ledger unit; not a refundable amount.

instance.description: Process-local HTTP counters; null if monitoring is unavailable. Restart resets counters. Not cluster totals.

created.description: 0 means creation time is not published by the gateway.
